scenes.headline: Coroutines in C, with a switch and __LINE__.
scenes.sub: Simon Tatham's classic trick, one step at a time.

items.text: crBegin: switch on the saved state
crReturn: save __LINE__, return, leave a case

scenes.label: the only locals that survive a crReturn: one shared instance
The idea
scenes.quote: a coroutine is just a state machine where the compiler tracks the state for you.

scenes.text: Save where you are, return, resume later: one switch, one __LINE__.

total: A state machine where the compiler tracks the state.
